name: faqgroup-update
description: A FAQ group update skill based on the Tradebee Website Builder Open API. Before sending the update request, it automatically reads the current FAQ group and writes a local JSON backup file containing the pre-update backup bundle.

language.description: Required. Exact site language code to update. First call `languages-get`, then copy one exact `language` value the user confirms.

faqgroup.description: Required. FAQ group fields to update. `faqgroup_id` is mandatory. Every other field is optional and should be omitted unless the user explicitly wants to change it.

faqgroup_id.description: Required. Existing FAQ group ID to update. First call `faqgroup-read`, then copy one exact `faqgroup_id`.

group_name.description: Optional. FAQ group name, up to 100 characters.

brief_description.description: Optional. Short plain-text description, up to 300 characters.

seo.description: Optional. FAQ group page SEO fields.

confirmation.description: Required. Proof that the user explicitly approved this exact FAQ group update request after seeing the final language and payload. That approval must also cover the automatic pre-update backup read and local backup file write before the update request is sent.

approved.description: Must be `true` only after the user explicitly confirms the language and exact FAQ group payload to be updated.

summary.description: Required confirmation note that restates the language and exact FAQ group payload shown to the user before execution.

faqgroup.faqgroup_id.description: Select one existing FAQ group ID from `faqgroup-read` under the same language.
